input.body: Brinewatch is built by Ana Ruiz and Theo Park. Ana leads hardware and spent nine years at a synthetic sensor company; her previous team shipped 2,000 marine sensors. Theo leads software and has built two public dashboards. We met volunteering on a beach clean-up, and together we have run water sensors on this coast for three years. Between those years in the water and Ana's experience shipping sensors at scale, we know firsthand how buoys fail in salt water.
